workflow.title: Overdue invoice reminders at 7, 21 and 45 days with run summary
workflow.goal: Find open invoices that are exactly 7, 21 or 45 days overdue, send each customer a reminder matching the stage (each send needs a person's approval), verify the sends, then send the user a summary of the run.

assumptions: Only invoices with status open are reminded; disputed and paid invoices are skipped.
A reminder fires when days overdue exactly equals 7, 21 or 45, so the flow must run once per day.
Recipients are the email column of the invoices sheet.
The summary goes to the user's own address, randstuff904@gmail.com, and needs approval before dispatch.
risks: If a scheduled run is skipped, invoices that reach a threshold on that day get no reminder.
If the flow runs more than once on the same day, the same reminders are sent again.
Each customer send is a live outbound message and requires a person's approval before dispatch.
successCriteria: Every reminder that was routed has been sent and independently confirmed by outbox.check.
outbox.audit confirms the recipients of this run match the expected list.
The summary email is sent and confirmed by outbox.check.
The number of reminders sent equals the number of routed invoices.

nodes.description: Compute whole days overdue from the due date.
Keep invoices exactly 7, 21 or 45 days overdue.
Attach the reminder stage, subject and wording to each invoice.

set.subject: Payment reminder: invoice 7 days overdue
set.template:
Hello {{customer}},

Invoice {{invoice}} for {{amount}} was due on {{due}} and is now 7 days overdue. Please arrange payment at your earliest convenience. If you have already paid, please disregard this message.

set.subject: Second reminder: invoice 21 days overdue
set.template:
Hello {{customer}},

This is a second reminder that invoice {{invoice}} for {{amount}}, due on {{due}}, is now 21 days overdue. Please arrange payment as soon as possible or contact us about it. If you have already paid, please disregard this message.

set.subject: Final reminder: invoice 45 days overdue
set.template:
Hello {{customer}},

Final reminder: invoice {{invoice}} for {{amount}}, due on {{due}}, is now 45 days overdue. Please pay now or contact us immediately to avoid further action. If you have already paid, please disregard this message.

nodes.description: Compose, send and verify one reminder per routed invoice. Each send needs a person's approval.
Fill the reminder wording for this invoice.
Send the reminder to the customer (asks a person first).
Re-read the sent reminder and compare its hash.
List the recipient emails of the routed invoices.
Confirm this run's outbox messages match the expected recipients and hashes.
One summary line per reminded invoice.
Send the run summary to the user (asks a person first).
Re-read the summary email and compare its hash.

outbox.subject: Overdue invoice reminders summary
outbox.body:
Overdue invoice reminder run 2026-10-20T09:00:00Z
Reminders sent: 0
Total value reminded: 0

No reminders were due today.

checks.plain: Every reminder that was routed has been sent and independently confirmed by outbox.check.
checks.exact: the pass of “Confirm this run's outbox messages match the expected recipients and hashes.” equals true

checks.plain: outbox.audit confirms the recipients of this run match the expected list.
checks.exact: the pass of “Re-read the summary email and compare its hash.” equals true

checks.plain: The summary email is sent and confirmed by outbox.check.
checks.exact: the count of “Compose, send and verify one reminder per routed invoice. Each send needs a person's approval.” equals the count of “Attach the reminder stage, subject and wording to each invoice.”

checks.plain: Confirm this run's outbox messages match the expected recipients and hashes.
Re-read the summary email and compare its hash.
